questions.answer_sentence: Poor hours follow the afternoon and September. Roadside stations have fewer Low hours, not more hours at or above 7.

questions.text: Relationship between project weather and AQHI.
questions.answer_sentence: Hotter days have a lower daily maximum AQHI because the hot months are cleaner. Within a month that link flips and is weak. Hourly rain disappears; daily rain shrinks but stays negative.

questions.text: Conditions that raise the chance of going outside safely.
questions.answer_sentence: At Sham Shui Po, Kwun Tong, and Sha Tin, stay in when the score is at or above the fit-year threshold that holds the false-positive rate to 20%.

decision_time: the clock hour of the reading
useless_columns: Daily Max rows are held out of the hourly rates
entity_risk: A trailing asterisk means the station was down and a similar station was substituted.
graph_reason: No coordinates and no edge list in aqhi_data.csv. Region and roadside are labels, not a graph.
split_rule: Describe 2021–2025. Fit the three-station score on the years with hourly weather and check it on 2024–2025. The threshold is not chosen on the check years.
